description: Segment a brain MRI of any contrast or resolution with FreeSurfer's SynthSeg (mri_synthseg): subcortical structures and, with parc, the Desikan-Killiany cortical parcels, as a FreeSurfer label map resampled to 1 mm, plus a CSV of structure volumes.

t1.description: Brain MRI, any contrast or resolution; full head or skull-stripped.

robust.description: Use the robust model (for clinical or low-quality scans; slower).

labels.description: SynthSeg label map (FreeSurfer label ids), with its FreeSurferColorLUT colour table beside it as synthseg.json.

volumes.description: Volume of each structure in mm³ (CSV).

requirements: FreeSurfer 7.3 or newer (no license needed for this tool); under /Applications/freesurfer/*, /usr/local/freesurfer*, or FREESURFER_HOME
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs mri_synthseg --i <t1> --o synthseg.nii.gz --vol volumes.csv [--parc] [--robust] --threads <threads> through the shared native CLI adapter.

probe.advice: This FreeSurfer has no usable mri_synthseg; install FreeSurfer 7.3 or newer.

neuroflow/cli.source: https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/fswiki/SynthSeg (Billot et al., Medical Image Analysis 2023; PNAS 2023)

useWhen: Segment a brain MRI of any contrast or resolution into FreeSurfer labels locally, with a table of structure volumes.
Show FreeSurfer's SynthSeg running on a volume in about a minute.

avoidWhen.when: FreeSurfer is not installed but the Neurodesk Webapps suite is.
You need cortical surfaces or thickness: that is recon-all, which takes hours.

preconditions: t1 is a NIfTI brain MRI.
effects: Writes synthseg.nii.gz (1 mm, FreeSurfer label ids), its colour table synthseg.json, and volumes.csv to the output directory.
The label map is on a 1 mm grid aligned to the input, not the input's own grid.

duration.basis: Apple-silicon Mac, CPU, all cores, FreeSurfer dev 2024-03, 0.88 mm T1: 38 s with parc; 68 s with parc and robust on 8 threads.

examples.title: Robust model for a clinical scan

failures.meaning: No FreeSurfer install with this command was found.
failures.remedy: Install FreeSurfer 7.3 or newer, or set MRI_SYNTHSEG to the command's path.
Read the step log, and check that t1 is a readable NIfTI with neuroflow_inspect.
